significance: A hill shrine to Srinivasa in Gundlupet taluk of Chamarajanagar district, also known as Huligadri, Vyagrachala and Dakshina Seshadri.
story: The Varaha Purana is said to call the hill Dakshina Sheshadri, where Srinivasa was worshipped by Rama in the Treta Yuga and by the Pandavas in the Dvapara Yuga, and where he blessed the sage Mandavya after a long penance.
